LanguageData.AAVPE_Electrified.label: наэлектризован
LanguageData.AAVPE_Electrified.description: This colonist or animal had its blood charged with reverse entropy potential, allowing them to recharge electrical batteries merely by being close to them. This change is permanent, and quite traumatic.
LanguageData.AAVPE_Exploder.label: химтопливные наросты
LanguageData.AAVPE_Exploder.description: Псионически внедрённые капсулы химтоплива в теле. Существо взорвётся при гибели.
LanguageData.AAVPE_FungalSkin.label: грибная кожа
LanguageData.AAVPE_Hover.label: парение
LanguageData.AAVPE_Hover.description: Limited psychic flight that allows this colonist or animal to hop and glide small distances over terrain. They will ignore terrain movement costs for the duration of the ability.
LanguageData.AAVPE_KO.label: без сознания
LanguageData.AAVPE_KO.description: This person was struck by such psychic energy that they are unable to move.
LanguageData.AAVPE_LightSustenance.label: пониженный аппетит
LanguageData.AAVPE_LightSustenance.description: This colonist or animal has had part of its skin replaced with plant material, eliminating almost entirely their need to eat, but requiring them to be constantly exposed to light for sustenance. This change is permanent, and quite traumatic.
LanguageData.AAVPE_Regeneration.label: регенерация
LanguageData.AAVPE_Regeneration.description: This colonist or animal has a psychically active field of regeneration, allowing them to heal their wounds much faster than usual.
LanguageData.AAVPE_StrengthenBlackHive.label: усиленный инсектоид
LanguageData.AAVPE_StrengthenBlackHive.description: Этот инсектоид Чёрного Улья был усилен псионикой и стал значительно эффективнее в бою.
LanguageData.AA_AcidBuildup_AgainstMechs.label: кислотный ожог
LanguageData.AA_AcidBuildup_AgainstMechs.description: Едкий налёт кислоты, продолжающий разъедать плоть и металл долгое время после удара. Воздействует даже на механоидов, обычно неуязвимых к кислоте!
LanguageData.AA_AcidicSpitterImplant.label: кислотный плеватель
LanguageData.AA_AcidicSpitterImplant.description: Кислотный плеватель. Позволяет существу атаковать врагов на расстоянии едкой кислотой с периодическим уроном.
LanguageData.AA_AnoleGrown.label: взрывной рост
LanguageData.AA_AnoleGrown.description: Нестабильный коктейль гормонов роста и механитов вызывает лавинообразное деление клеток. Значительно повышает метаболизм, боевую мощь и защиту существа на несколько часов. После этого существо будет истощено.
LanguageData.AA_AnoleGrownExhausted.label: взрывной рост (истощение)
LanguageData.AA_AnoleGrownExhausted.description: Существо недавно пережило аномальный гормональный скачок, что вызвало сильное истощение и зверский голод. Повторная активация невозможна, пока этот эффект не спадёт.
LanguageData.AA_AteBlackTruffleIngredient.label: съел чёрный трюфель (в блюде)
LanguageData.AA_AteBlackTruffleIngredient.description: Съел чёрный трюфель — восхитительный и ценнейший деликатесный гриб.
LanguageData.AA_AteFinestClothes.label: пиршество легендарной тканью
LanguageData.AA_AteFinestClothes.description: Эта ангельская моль недавно полакомилась одеждой легендарного качества.
LanguageData.AA_BarbedQuillThrowerImplant.label: шипомётный имплант
LanguageData.AA_BarbedQuillThrowerImplant.description: Метатель зазубренных игл. Наделяет существо токсичной дистанционной атакой.
LanguageData.AA_BioelectricOrganImplant.label: биоэлектрический имплант
LanguageData.AA_BioelectricOrganImplant.description: Биоэлектрический орган. Позволяет существу атаковать электрическими разрядами на дистанции, вызывая паралич и остановку сердца.
LanguageData.AA_BionicBeak.label: бионический клюв
LanguageData.AA_BionicBuoyancyMechanism.label: бионический механизм плавучести
LanguageData.AA_BionicBuoyancyMechanism.description: Improved bionic buoyancy mechanism for animals. Should be able to replace hydrogen sacs and other exotic organs keeping hovering creatures in the air.
LanguageData.AA_BionicMotionDetector.label: бионический детектор движения
LanguageData.AA_BionicMotionDetector.description: Improved bionic motion detector for animals. This motion detector replaces echolocation organs and vibration sensors.
LanguageData.AA_BionicShell.label: бионический панцирь
LanguageData.AA_BionicShell.description: Improved bionic shell for animals. Should be able to replace carapaces and shells.
LanguageData.AA_BionicTentacle.label: бионическое щупальце
LanguageData.AA_BionicWing.label: бионическое крыло
LanguageData.AA_BionicWing.description: Improved bionic wing for animals. Should be able to replace any type of wing.
LanguageData.AA_BurrowingUnderSand.label: зарывание в песок
LanguageData.AA_BurrowingUnderSand.description: This Sand Prowler is burrowing under the sand, making it very resistant to damage. I hate sand. Its course, and ruff, and irritating. And it gets everywhere.
LanguageData.AA_CarryWeight1.label: дополнительный вес (ужасный)
LanguageData.AA_CarryWeight1.description: This creature can carry extra weight both while hauling and on caravans.
LanguageData.AA_CarryWeight2.label: дополнительный вес (плохой)
LanguageData.AA_CarryWeight2.description: This creature can carry extra weight both while hauling and on caravans.
LanguageData.AA_CarryWeight3.label: дополнительный вес (нормальный)
LanguageData.AA_CarryWeight3.description: This creature can carry extra weight both while hauling and on caravans.
LanguageData.AA_CarryWeight4.label: дополнительный вес (хороший)
LanguageData.AA_CarryWeight4.description: This creature can carry extra weight both while hauling and on caravans.
LanguageData.AA_CarryWeight5.label: дополнительный вес (отличный)
LanguageData.AA_CarryWeight5.description: This creature can carry extra weight both while hauling and on caravans.
LanguageData.AA_CarryWeight6.label: дополнительный вес (шедевр)
LanguageData.AA_CarryWeight6.description: This creature can carry extra weight both while hauling and on caravans.
LanguageData.AA_CarryWeight7.label: легендарная грузоподъёмность
LanguageData.AA_CarryWeight7.description: This creature can carry extra weight both while hauling and on caravans.
LanguageData.AA_CorpseFeast.label: пировал человеческими телами
LanguageData.AA_CorpseFeast.description: This Helixien slug has recently fed on human corpses. The tastiest meat.
LanguageData.AA_CrushingEverything.label: сокрушает всё на пути
LanguageData.AA_CrushingEverything.description: If I were you, I wouldn't get in the path of a rampaging Summit Crab...
LanguageData.AA_DesertPelt.label: пустынная шкура
LanguageData.AA_DesertPelt.description: This animal is sporting a nice desert pelt, giving it great resistance against the heat.
LanguageData.AA_EatenACorpse.label: съел труп
LanguageData.AA_EatenACorpse.description: Erins love a good, tasty corpse. Eating a fresh corpse will provide the Erin with a considerable boost to its health for almost half a day.
LanguageData.AA_EcholocativeFeedbackLoop.label: эхолокационная петля
LanguageData.AA_EcholocativeFeedbackLoop.description: This person relies on echolocation instead of regular sight but environmental factors such as loud explosions can cause a debilitating feedback loop, causing sensory overload and confusion and driving them into a catatonic state.
LanguageData.AA_Electric.label: электроразряд
LanguageData.AA_FertilizedTerrain.label: удобренная почва
LanguageData.AA_FertilizedTerrain.description: This Sand Squid has recently fertilized some sandy terrain.
LanguageData.AA_GatheredResource.label: собран ресурс с животного
LanguageData.AA_GatheredResource.description: This colonist has recently gathered an animal resource.
LanguageData.AA_GooAcidifier.label: кислотный преобразователь слизи
LanguageData.AA_GooAcidifier.description: A goo acidifier increases the acidity of a goo's internal organs, making it explode as soon as it is downed. Basically transforms goos into biological suicide bombers.
LanguageData.AA_HorrifyingDread.label: ужасающий трепет
LanguageData.AA_HorrifyingDread.description: A primal sense of fear and terror caused by the presence of a grotesque fangsquid nearby.
LanguageData.AA_HyperAcidicStomachImplant.label: сверхацидный желудок
LanguageData.AA_HyperAcidicStomachImplant.description: Сверхацидный желудок. Занимает место желудка и позволяет изрыгать концентрированную кислоту.
LanguageData.AA_InvisibleArcticLion.label: выслеживание
LanguageData.AA_InvisibleArcticLion.description: This arctic lion is stalking its prey and... Hey, how are you reading this, you cheater??
LanguageData.AA_JunglePelt.label: шкура джунглей
LanguageData.AA_JunglePelt.description: This animal is sporting a nice jungle pelt, giving it slight resistance against the heat.
LanguageData.AA_Kamikaze.label: внезапная детонация
LanguageData.AA_Kamikaze.description: Существо сдетонирует при гибели, вызвав мощный взрыв.
LanguageData.AA_LightFocusingLensImplant.label: фокусирующая линза
LanguageData.AA_LightFocusingLensImplant.description: Фокусирующая линза. Концентрирует солнечную энергию в смертоносный лазерный луч.
LanguageData.AA_LockJawDisease.label: тризм челюстей
LanguageData.AA_LockJawDisease.description: A painful and uncomfortable disease that inflames the jaw, making it very hard to eat or talk. The disease will go away after it has been successfully treated a set number of times.
LanguageData.AA_LowRest.label: нуждается в минимуме сна
LanguageData.AA_LowRest.description: This creature has very little need for sleep, and can stay awake for a long time.
LanguageData.AA_LowRest_HighRank.label: нуждается в минимуме сна
LanguageData.AA_LowRest_HighRank.description: This creature has very little need for sleep, and can stay awake for a long time.
LanguageData.AA_LowRest_HighestRank.label: почти не нуждается во сне
LanguageData.AA_LowRest_HighestRank.description: This creature has almost no need for sleep, and can stay awake for an incredibly long time.
LanguageData.AA_LowRest_LowRank.label: нуждается в меньшем сне
LanguageData.AA_LowRest_LowRank.description: This creature has less need for sleep than other animals, and can stay awake for a bit longer.
LanguageData.AA_LowRest_LowestRank.label: обычная потребность во сне
LanguageData.AA_LowRest_LowestRank.description: Due to their poor genetics, this creature has the same need to sleep as any other animal.
LanguageData.AA_MalevolentEye.label: зловещее око
LanguageData.AA_MalevolentEye.description: Зловещий пульсирующий глаз мутанта, наделяющий владельца псионической аурой ужаса.
LanguageData.AA_MechDisruption.label: сбой механоидов
LanguageData.AA_MechDisruption.description: This mechanoid's targeting, speed and agility are being dirupted by a nearby bio mechanoid disruptor building.
LanguageData.AA_MechanoidRendingClaws.label: разрывающие когти механоида
LanguageData.AA_MechanoidRendingClaws.description: Тяжёлые серповидные манипуляторы, способные вспарывать броню и укрепления.
LanguageData.AA_MimeHediff.label: маскировка на виду
LanguageData.AA_MimeHediff.description: This colonist may not be a real person after all...
LanguageData.AA_MutantArm.label: мутантная рука
LanguageData.AA_MutantArm.description: This arm twitches and bends in strange unnatural ways, as if it had a mind of its own. Something seems... off about it, as if it wasn't a completely natural creation.
LanguageData.AA_MutantEye.label: мутантный глаз
LanguageData.AA_MutantEye.description: This eye constantly blinks on its own, like a nervous tic, and a second set of vertical eyelids seems to be present behind the normal, human ones. Something seems... off about it, as if it wasn't a completely natural creation.
LanguageData.AA_MutantLeg.label: мутантная лапа
LanguageData.AA_MutantLeg.description: Мутантная конечность. Значительно повышает скорость перемещения животного.
LanguageData.AA_NoPain.label: нечувствительность к боли
LanguageData.AA_NoPain.description: This creature has a reduced pain sensitivity, and it takes longer to be downed due to pain.
LanguageData.AA_Nocturnal.label: ночное животное
LanguageData.AA_Nocturnal.description: Deprecated nocturnal animal Hediff. This shouldn't ever appear in-game.
LanguageData.AA_Paralysis.label: паралич
LanguageData.AA_Paralysis.description: A fast acting toxin is coursing through this creature's veins, paralyzing his muscles. It will wear off after a while.
LanguageData.AA_PermanentBurn.label: перманентный ожог
LanguageData.AA_ProstheticBeak.label: простой протез клюва
LanguageData.AA_ProstheticBuoyancyMechanism.label: простой протез плавучести
LanguageData.AA_ProstheticBuoyancyMechanism.descripti: Simple prosthetic buoyancy mechanism. Should be able to replace hydrogen sacs and other exotic organs keeping hovering creatures in the air.
LanguageData.AA_ProstheticShell.label: простой протез панциря
LanguageData.AA_ProstheticShell.description: Simple prosthetic shell. Should be able to replace carapaces and shells.
LanguageData.AA_ProstheticTentacle.label: простой протез щупальца
LanguageData.AA_ProstheticWing.label: простой протез крыла
LanguageData.AA_ProstheticWing.description: Simple prosthetic wing. Should be able to replace any type of wing.
LanguageData.AA_PsionicallyNuzzled.label: псионическая ласка
LanguageData.AA_QuadTeslaCannonImplant.label: четырёхствольная тесла-пушка
LanguageData.AA_QuadTeslaCannonImplant.description: Четырёхствольная тесла-пушка. Плазменная турель, вживлённая в тело зверя.
LanguageData.AA_RangedSpinneretImplant.label: дистанционная паутина
LanguageData.AA_RangedSpinneretImplant.description: Дистанционная паутина. Позволяет опутать и обездвижить приближающихся врагов.
LanguageData.AA_RechargingBatteries.label: перезарядка батарей
LanguageData.AA_RechargingBatteries.description: This creature has recently recharged a nearby battery.
LanguageData.AA_Resurrection.label: восстань из могилы!
LanguageData.AA_Resurrection.description: This animal can survive up to 9 fatal wounds, coming back from the dead.
LanguageData.AA_SwarmlingImplantation.label: имплантация роевика
LanguageData.AA_SwarmlingImplantation.description: Вживлённые личинки роя, развивающиеся в подкожных тканях.
LanguageData.AA_TheHeuristicEye.label: эвристический глаз
LanguageData.AA_TheHeuristicEye.description: This eye analyzes its surroundings with carefully planned discipline, missing no details.
LanguageData.AA_TheMeretriciousEye.label: соблазнительный глаз
LanguageData.AA_TheMeretriciousEye.description: This gaudy looking eye seems to have a life of its own, trying to catch the attention of other people with carefully directed winks and furtive, sultry glances that beckon with a false allure. It allows its host to recover quicker from psychic exhaustion.
LanguageData.AA_TheNumbingEye.label: ошеломляющий глаз
LanguageData.AA_TheNumbingEye.description: This strange mutant eye is covered by dense plates of bone instead of a normal fleshy eyelid, and seems to be almost impervious to pain.
LanguageData.AA_TheOmniscientEye.label: всевидящий глаз
LanguageData.AA_TheOmniscientEye.description: Всевидящее око. Ужасный мутантный орган с треугольным зрачком, наделяющий владельца псионическим зрением.
LanguageData.AA_TheQuiescentEye.label: умиротворяющий глаз
LanguageData.AA_TheQuiescentEye.description: An eye that never blinks, keeping itself moist by unknown means. It pervades its host with a sense of preternatural calmness.
LanguageData.AA_TheRecalcitrantEye.label: строптивый глаз
LanguageData.AA_TheRecalcitrantEye.description: Упорствующий глаз. Мутантный полуприкрытый глаз, защищающий носителя от психических воздействий.
LanguageData.AA_TheSpasmodicEye.label: судорожный глаз
LanguageData.AA_TheSpasmodicEye.description: An eye that can't stop blinking uncontrollably. While extremely distracting and disconcerting, it allows its host to cast more psychic powers before exhaustion.
LanguageData.AA_ToxicBuildup.label: токсичное отравление
LanguageData.AA_ToxicBuildup.description: Toxins in the bloodstream. This can come from various sources, including environmental toxins, venomous bites, or poisoned weapons. \nAt high doses, toxic buildup is lethal. Even at low doses, it can generate cancers. \nContrary to base game toxic buildup, creatures who die with this toxic damage can be eaten.
LanguageData.AA_VenomousSpitterImplant.label: ядовитый плеватель
LanguageData.AA_VenomousSpitterImplant.description: Ядовитый плеватель. Позволяет поражать цели ядовитыми зарядами на расстоянии.
LanguageData.AA_VirulentFungalInfection.label: опасная грибковая инфекция
LanguageData.AA_VirulentFungalInfection.description: Fungal infection in a wound. Without treatment, the infection will advance at an astonishing rate, killing the afflicted in a few hours. Luckily, it is very easy to treat, and it will be kept contained and disappear as long as a medic treats it fast and with a decent treatment quality.
LanguageData.AA_WinterPelt.label: зимняя шкура
LanguageData.AA_WinterPelt.description: This animal is sporting a nice winter pelt, giving it good resistance against the cold.
LanguageData.AB_BionicClaw.label: бионический коготь
LanguageData.AB_BionicClaw.description: Улучшенный бионический коготь из прочных сплавов для опасных хищников.
LanguageData.AB_SimpleProstheticClaw.label: простой протез когтя
LanguageData.AB_SimpleProstheticClaw.description: Простой протез когтя для восстановления боеспособности животного.
LanguageData.VFEI2_BlackEmpressSpawn.label: зародыш чёрной императрицы
